name: Jack Newton
current_role: Co-founder & CEO, Clio (legal practice management / legal AI software, Vancouver)
profile: Canadian software entrepreneur who co-founded Clio in 2008 with Rian Gauvreau, pioneering cloud-based practice management for lawyers. In Nov 2025 Clio closed the US$1B acquisition of vLex (largest legal-tech M&A ever) alongside a US$500M Series G at a US$5B valuation; Newton is pushing Clio into AI-powered legal research and workflows.
interesting_fact: The vLex deal was described as the largest M&A transaction ever in legal technology, and was announced together with a US$500M Series G at a US$5B valuation.
deep_cut_fact: Before Clio, he was the first software developer at Chenomx, a University of Alberta spinoff building an NMR-based medical diagnostic tool, and took a sabbatical from it to do an MSc in machine learning under Russ Greiner; he started programming around age eight on an IBM 8086.
notes: Very public CEO; author of 'The Client-Centered Law Firm'; frequent conference keynoter (ClioCon). Press route via Clio media team.

name: Kanav Hasija
current_role: Co-founder and Chief Customer Officer (previously Chief Product Officer), Innovaccer (San Francisco)
profile: IIT Kharagpur graduate who co-founded healthcare data/AI company Innovaccer with Abhinav Shashank and Sandeep Gupta. He built the company's Data Activation Platform underlying its Health Cloud. Innovaccer raised a US$275M Series F in Jan 2025 (backers incl. B Capital, Kaiser Permanente, M12), with press estimates above US$3B valuation.
interesting_fact: Innovaccer's Series F in January 2025 drew strategic health-system investors such as Kaiser Permanente and Banner Health alongside Microsoft's M12 and Danaher Ventures.
deep_cut_fact: An engineer by training, he went to the US after IIT Kharagpur to earn a master's in patent law at the University of New Hampshire; as an undergrad he interned at General Electric and was a principal consultant at the student-run Kharagpur Consulting Group.
notes: Lower public profile than CEO Abhinav Shashank. Press email is the named press contact on Innovaccer's Jan 2025 release; may change.
